name: Simpinby Invoice Manager – GST Billing & PDF Invoice Plugin
author: shouviktrivedy

sections.description:
Simpinby Invoice Manager – GST Billing & PDF Invoice Plugin is a clean, fast, and professional invoicing solution built directly for WordPress.

Create invoices, manage customers, apply GST/VAT or custom taxes, generate PDF invoices, send invoices via email, and manage billing — all from your WordPress dashboard.

Perfect for freelancers, agencies, consultants, service providers, and small businesses.

Smart Invoice Creation

  • Create invoices with full customer details
  • Auto search customers while creating invoices
  • Auto search products while creating invoices
  • Add multiple invoice items (rows)
  • Automatic invoice number generation
  • Custom invoice number prefix & padding

Flexible Tax, Discount & Multi-Currency

  • GST / VAT / Custom tax support
  • Create multiple tax rules
  • Set default tax
  • Discount support (flat or percentage)
  • Multi-currency support (configurable from Display & PDF Settings)
  • Accurate invoice calculations

Invoice Management System

  • Invoice listing with pagination
  • Advanced invoice filters:
    • Date range
    • Invoice number
    • Customer search
  • Mark invoice as Paid / Unpaid
  • Archive and Unarchive invoices
  • Clean invoice status tracking

Professional PDF & Email Integration

  • Download invoice as professional PDF
  • Customizable PDF layout
  • Send invoice via email with PDF attachment
  • Display & PDF settings configuration
  • Printable invoice format

Built for Performance

  • Uses custom database tables for fast invoice management
  • Secure invoice number generation (prevents duplicates)
  • AJAX actions for Paid/Unpaid and Archive/Unarchive (no page reload)
  • Lightweight and optimized code

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Freelancers
  • Agencies
  • Consultants
  • Service providers
  • Small businesses
  • WordPress site owners who need internal billing

100% WordPress Based

No external SaaS required. Everything runs inside your WordPress website.

Pro Version (Coming Soon)

A Pro version is coming soon with advanced premium features including recurring invoices, automation tools, and enhanced reporting.

Support

Support Email: eternity.v.tech@gmail.com
WhatsApp: +918981223617
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ OR install from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Invoice Management from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure settings from Invoice Management → Settings.
  5. Configure currency and PDF display settings under Display & PDF Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin generate PDF invoices?

Yes. You can download invoices as PDF from the invoice view page.

Can I send invoice PDFs by email?

Yes. You can send invoice PDF via email directly from WordPress admin.

Does it support GST or VAT tax?

Yes. You can create multiple tax rules including GST, VAT, or custom taxes.

Does it support multiple currencies?

Yes. Multi-currency support is available from Display & PDF Settings.

Which currencies are supported?

Simpinby Invoice Manager supports the following currencies:

• ₹ Indian Rupee (INR)
• $ US Dollar (USD)
• € Euro (EUR)
• £ British Pound (GBP)
• د.إ UAE Dirham (AED)
• ﷼ Saudi Riyal (SAR)
• $ Canadian Dollar (CAD)
• $ Australian Dollar (AUD)

You can configure your preferred currency from the Display & PDF Settings section.

Can I change invoice number prefix?

Yes. You can set invoice number prefix and padding from Settings.

Does it support recurring invoices?

Recurring invoices will be available in the Pro version.
